title: A Funny Way of Helping
description: A Funny Way of Helping — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Unknown

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Travel to Townston. Have any trainer sign your certificate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Unknown

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Unraveling the Red Tape

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Travel to Townston. Have any trainer sign your certificate.

Offer:

Back again? Come back in three weeks and we'll straighten things out.

Ugh, are you going to cry? I think you're going to cry. I can't handle this today.

...Okay, fine. We can straighten this out now, but you owe me one! No offense, but you don't seem very bright, so I'll outline the entire process for you.

Take this unsigned certificate. Go to the Dew Valley Obelisk. Use the Obelisk to magically teleport to Townston. In Townston, ask any trainer to sign your certificate. (Lothar of the Mound People, Abel Tukahst, and Gwen of the Tree Folk are near the obelisk.) Take the signed certificate from the trainer. Go to the Townston Obelisk. Return to Dew Valley. Give me the signed certificate.

There...simple enough, isn't it?

Tip: An Obelisk is a tall, dark, magical monument used for traveling to safe areas around the world.

New Obelisks need to be unlocked to be used; whenever you first encounter any Obelisk, make sure to click on it to unlock it.

Clicking on an Obelisk will show you a list of all the places that you can travel to.

Turn-in:

Hello! I am a skills trainer. Can I help you with something?

Deidre the Resourceful sent you to me to sign your certificate? Very well, give me your certificate and I'll do what I can.

Tip: As you gain additional levels and gold, you will be able to purchase more skills. You can press P to open your skill menu and then click-and-drag skill icons to the skillbar at the bottom of your screen.

Level range: 1–5
